orphans.feature: UPL Decision Request dan Endorsement di staff portal (per notice UPL): Propose composition amount/stage, lalu endorse; memanggil workitem, workflow UPL_APPROVAL, approvalinbox
orphans.note: The propose-then-endorse pattern is similar to story 48.8, but for UPL notices, one notice per action, not bulk court notices. The workitem/workflow/approvalinbox backend does not exist in the repo (ticket OCMS-SR-2026-155). Possibly covered by another UPL story. Not claimed.

orphans.feature: Cloudflare Turnstile captcha untuk pencarian Vehicle Number dan Notice Number
orphans.note: The UI requires a Turnstile captcha before the Search Fines button is enabled on tabs 2 and 3, and a token validation endpoint exists. The @RequireTurnstile annotation is not used on any controller, so /v1/parkingfines does not check the captcha in the backend. No story in OCMS50.1-50.5 covers the captcha; not checked against stories of other epics.

orphans.feature: Tab Paid dan unduh receipt untuk pencarian lewat login (record dibayar 6 bulan terakhir)
orphans.note: After login the user can switch to the Paid tab, see notices with status FP and download the receipt (printslip). The ID query limits paid data with a 6-month window (crs_date_of_suspension >= DATEADD(MONTH,-6,GETDATE())). Stories OCMS50.1-50.5 only mention outstanding fines; not checked against stories of other epics.

orphans.feature: Blokir pembayaran saat transaksi masih diproses (pesan E10 dalam 300 detik, E11 setelah itu)
orphans.note: If the latest web transaction has not succeeded within 300 seconds, the notice is marked not payable (E10, status Processing Payment); after that E11 applies and a retry is allowed. No story in OCMS50.1-50.5 covers this rule; it may belong to another payment story, not checked.

orphans.feature: Mode bypass SPCP untuk environment dev
orphans.note: With spcp.bypass.enabled=true (only in application-dev.properties) the Singpass/Corppass login is skipped and the session is created from the NRIC in the properties. uat/prod do not set this flag so it defaults to false; the real server value cannot verify from repo. A testing aid, not a user feature; no need to claim it.

orphans.feature: Daftar eksklusi e-notification (opt-out) dikelola staff: halaman Exclusion dan CRUD ocms_enotification_exclusion_list
orphans.note: Similar to story OCMS50.10 (Removed) but only staff fill the id_no list; offenders have no option of their own in the portal. No SMS vs email channel column. The delete and exists endpoints are not in the api-authorization.properties:156 mapping.

orphans.feature: Cron notifikasi SMS/email melewati ID yang ada di daftar eksklusi (ENA dipindah ke RD1 jalur kertas)
orphans.note: The opt-out effect lives in the cron: excluded IDs are skipped and the ENA stage moves to RD1 the next day. loadAllExcludedIds is fail-open (empty set when the query fails). Prod properties sms.enable=false (application-prod.properties:87) and email.enableSmtp=false (:80); the real server values cannot verify from repo.

orphans.feature: Penahan transaksi tertunda 5 menit (E10/E11) dan status 'Processing Payment' pada daftar fine
orphans.note: When a notice's last transaction is not successful and is still within 300 seconds, the notice is blocked with message E10 and shows 'Processing Payment' without a checkbox; after 5 minutes message E11 appears and the notice can be paid again. No story in epic 50 mentions blocking duplicate payments. Related ticket OCMS-DF-2026-026 (Closed, Prod deployed).

orphans.feature: Deklarasi tambahan untuk fine di stage warrant (COW/CWW/CWM/CTW/CWT) sebelum pembayaran
orphans.note: When any selected fine is at a warrant stage, 'Proceed to Payment' opens the warrant version of the process page (InitPaymentWarrant) with an extra declaration. No epic 50 story mentions this declaration. The declaration content and its rule basis: cannot verify from repo.

orphans.feature: Field email opsional pada permintaan transaksi, diteruskan ke payment gateway
orphans.note: The API accepts an optional email (no format validation) and forwards it to the gateway, but the portal never sends it and nothing emails the receipt. The OCMS50.14 verdict stays Removed.

orphans.feature: Blokir pembayaran 5 menit setelah transaksi dimulai (pesan E10 'sedang diproses' dan E11 'lewat 5 menit') pada pencarian denda eService
orphans.note: The last non-S transaction per notice (including E) blocks repeat payment for 300 seconds and shows message E10, then E11 afterwards. No story states this rule; used as Sebagian evidence in OCMS50.20. Related to OCMS-DF-2026-026.

orphans.feature: Tombol Download Receipt(s) pada tab notice yang sudah dibayar (unduh ZIP receipt PDF tanpa melewati alur bayar)
orphans.note: The offender can download receipts of already paid notices from the search result, outside the success page. It is unclear whether another epic 50 story covers this; not claimed as an OCMS50.19 step.

orphans.feature: Pelacakan transaksi WOGAA (StartTS saat Pay Now, CompleteTS saat halaman hasil tampil, termasuk untuk hasil gagal)
orphans.note: CompleteTS is called for both success and failure results, relevant to the OCMS-SR-2026-186 investigation (7,843 started vs 81 completed). No story mentions this tracking.
